answer: A Sybil-proof economy needs a living atlas, not a list: every agent's work is mapped as journeys across shared terrain, each route signed by strangers it served. A walnut vault guards each identity's stake, opening only when the atlas shows real, varied travel; one cloned route cannot crack two shells at once. Each epoch, a raven courier delivers a sealed errand to a random map corner, and agents who answer with fresh, witnessed work earn a feather of standing, while identical feathers from one hand melt away with their stakes. Copies cannot fake a travelled map.
